series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: First Snow
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 1: the first snow falls on the lane, and Cancer realises their best friend is the first person they want to tell everything. Crushes on friends are normal. Going quiet isn't the answer; showing up is.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: The Market Stall
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 2: the holiday market opens, and Sagittarius will not let anyone help. Not even Cancer. Letting someone hold the ladder isn't weakness. It's closeness. Practise saying yes, thank you.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: The Borrowed Scarf
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 3: day four of keeping the borrowed scarf, and Cancer has a nine-card speech ready. A gift can't say what you mean. One warm, simple line can.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Two Invitations, One Night
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 4: Libra says yes to a party and a midnight bake on the same night. Splitting yourself in half means nobody gets you. Choose, then tell the other person kindly and early.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Snowed In
old_caption: Moonlight Lane, Ep 5: the whole lane is snowed in at the café, a talk card goes round, and Sagittarius answers with a fun fact. When a moment gets real, try staying in it instead of joking your way out.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Ep 6: The Gift That Says Too Much
old_caption:
Moonlight Lane, Ep 6: Cancer drew Sagittarius in the lane gift swap and made something way too meaningful. Then called it a joke.
A gift can be honest. Say what it means, small, and let them keep it.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Ep 7: Dinner with the Parents
old_caption:
Moonlight Lane, Ep 7: Sag's parents are big huggers, and Cancer is the plus one "as a friend." It goes well until one sentence comes out too loud.
You don't owe anyone a label, but you can stay kind.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Ep 8: The Long Way Home
old_caption:
Moonlight Lane, Ep 8: Three tries, three interruptions and one very short shortcut.
Nervous usually means it matters. If you don't want the walk to end, ask for one more block.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Ep 9: What We Didn't Say
old_caption:
Moonlight Lane, Ep 9: One table, one talk card, and everyone tells the truth except the two who need to most.
Big things deserve a quiet moment. Say it to them, not the room.

series: Moonlight Lane, Season 2: Winter on the Lane
title: Ep 10: Lights on the Lane
old_caption:
Moonlight Lane, Ep 10: Christmas Eve, the lights won't come on, and two people on a roof are trying very hard to be cool.
The finale. Cool is easy. Clear is kind.
